question: Goitre is caused due to the deficiency of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**iodine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Goitre is a deficiency disease caused due to deficiency of iodine in our diet.**
 
• Iodine is commonly consumed in the form of iodized salt in the diet.
 
• Goitre is an enlargement of the thyroid gland which is directly involved in the secretion that leads to goitre.
